description: Tests detection of techniques used to elevate from standard user to SYSTEM or administrator

vectors.name: Process Hollowing
vectors.description: Spawns a legitimate suspended process and replaces its image with a malicious payload, then resumes execution. Tests whether AV/EDR detects memory-resident code injection.

vectors.name: UAC Bypass (fodhelper.exe)
vectors.description: Leverages the fodhelper.exe auto-elevation path to execute a payload with elevated privileges without triggering a UAC prompt. No admin rights required to attempt.

vectors.name: Living-off-the-Land (LOLBin) Signed Binary
vectors.description: Abuses a Microsoft-signed binary (LOLBin) to proxy execution of an unsigned payload, evading application whitelisting and binary-trust policies.
